decision_availability_rule: available_at <= decision_at; execute only on a later permitted dealing event
universe_rule: freeze owner-approved fund classes, share classes, substitutes and point-in-time eligibility
evidence_rule: previously inspected history is development evidence, never a new independent holdout
required_inputs_before_acceptance: confirmed strategic class weights, target basis and policy version
starting positions, settled cash and receivables with separate contributions and withdrawals
dated dealing eligibility, lot fees, cash reservations and settlement assumptions
experiment log and frozen code/data hashes
incremental maintenance hours, value of time and execution cost uncertainty
common inflation series and purchasing-power base; otherwise nominal-only results

chronological_splits.window_comparison_rule: same longest-window warmup and identical evaluation dates for every compared configuration
chronological_splits.interpretation: governance screening minimum, not statistical power or future-return assurance
chronological_splits.candidate_parameter_refitting: fixed algorithm may re-estimate on prior data only; no final-period policy tuning

baselines.rule: fixed approved class weights, contributions by class weight, no timing
same target, buy-only contribution allocation by class gaps
same target, new-money-first allocation plus approved fee-aware rebalancing
equal weights between approved classes, then approved within-class fund allocation

candidate.rule: research-only Kelly candidate with corrected account/benchmark semantics
candidate.separate_ablation: fix targets to isolate timing; fix timing to isolate target estimation

primary_metric_proposal.alternative_if_goal_is_confirmed: precommit shortfall loss as the primary metric before seeing test results
primary_metric_proposal.withdrawals: identical dated withdrawals for every strategy; an unmet withdrawal is a recorded failure

secondary_metrics: daily account unit-NAV drawdown where evidence permits
21-dealing-day CVaR at 95 percent with overlap diagnostics
real terminal wealth and dated withdrawal fulfillment
class deviations, turnover, fees and discretionary cash-day balance
order count, manual minutes, fallback counts and outstanding receivables

uncertainty_diagnostics.method: paired moving-block bootstrap of realized net account return vectors, rebuild terminal wealth with identical frozen external flows
uncertainty_diagnostics.flow_timing: monthly recursion is valid only for beginning-month contributions and end-month withdrawals; otherwise use event-subperiod returns
uncertainty_diagnostics.multiplicity: alpha / K for K tested final candidates; unknown trial history invalidates a corrected-significance claim
uncertainty_diagnostics.scope: conditional on observed return paths and dependence assumptions; not new independent markets or a full policy replay on resampled markets

joint_shocks: equity decline, bond decline and low-volatility sleeve loss together
all purchases suspended with same dated contributions
high redemption fee and unsettled proceeds
data outage, solver failure and stale confirmed target
sensitivity_development_only.rule: report every configuration, including unavailable or failed runs; stress scenarios receive no invented probabilities

acceptance_proposal.engineering: no cent-ledger imbalance, overspend, unmodeled dealing rule or worsening avoidable reserve shortfall
acceptance_proposal.economic: observed primary wealth improvement exceeds the owner-approved hurdle
acceptance_proposal.uncertainty: one-sided lower diagnostic bound exceeds that hurdle for all declared block lengths; otherwise remain experimental
acceptance_proposal.insufficient_risk_evidence: remain experimental; never convert unavailable estimates to zero or remove a gate after seeing results
acceptance_proposal.risk_margin_failure_action: do not promote candidate; still produce a feasible monthly baseline plan
acceptance_proposal.promotion: requires all gates and explicit owner acceptance of the policy change
acceptance_proposal.retention: freeze version, retain logging, review operating quality quarterly and economic evidence on predeclared dates
acceptance_proposal.retirement: remove research candidate from active comparison after one completed final evaluation fails the agreed hurdle; archive code and results
